creation.prompt: Create one full-body Milo seed-inspection pose on true transparent alpha. Image 1 controls canonical identity, anatomy, felt material and palette. Image 2 is the primary pose/proportion reference: preserve its head-to-torso balance, readable upper chest, lean waist and leg lengths. Begin from the upright berry-inspection pose and change only the acting: lower the raised arm toward hip/knee height, open the hand gently as if about to inspect a seed, and direct the eyes downward. Keep the torso nearly upright with a shallow knee bend and very small forward hinge. Keep the skull above the shoulders, with a clearly visible short natural neck transition and upper chest between chin and shoulders; shoulders relaxed and lower than the jaw. Do not add a long neck or change species. The hand need not touch the ground: this is the start of seed inspection, avoiding a deep crouch that compresses the torso. Restrained three-quarter screen-right view, no head thrust toward camera, no foreshortened tiny torso, no swollen belly or oversized head. Preserve full ears, green eyes, grey needle-felt wool, cream muzzle and chest inset, charcoal nose, orange tail, closed mouth and no visible teeth. All ears, tail, hands and feet inside frame with margin; feet share a support plane. One mouse only, neutral studio illumination, no seeds, props, ground, shadow, forest, text or watermark. Preserve real transparent background.
